blocks.text: The greeting "Hello" is a common salutation used to acknowledge someone's presence or arrival. It can be employed as both an informal and formal way of addressing another person in English-speaking societies worldwide. The term originated from the Old High German word 'hallo,' which meant either now, here, or oath (a solemn promise). Over time it has evolved into a standard greeting we use to initiate conversation with someone else when meeting them face to face in English-speaking cultures today.
